page.content:
Thin-skinned red of Burgundy and a Champagne blending grape.

How Pinot Noir connects

  • Item: Vitis vinifera — Pinot Noir is a Vitis vinifera variety.
  • Location: Burgundy — Pinot Noir is the red grape of Burgundy's Côte d'Or.
  • Location: Champagne — Pinot Noir is one of Champagne's three permitted grapes.

What is Pinot Noir?

Pinot Noir is Burgundy's red and one of Champagne's three. It is the grape terroir talk most often uses as a sensitive instrument.

Key threads lead to Vitis vinifera, Burgundy and Champagne.
